description.value: Channeling restorative energy into a creature you touch, you may lift one debilitating affliction from it. Choose to reduce the target's exhaustion by one level, or end one of the following: a charm effect on it, a curse (including attunement to a cursed item), any drain to one of its ability scores, or any reduction of its hit point maximum.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 5
